description: This is a localization file for the Select2 plugin, providing translations of UI messages into the Turkmen language (tk). It defines the translations for various messages such as errors, loading, and search prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when an error occurs during data loading.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the input is too long, specifying how many characters need to be removed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to add more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Indicates the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Message shown when a search is in progress.
